_doc: ONE-SHOT, DIGEST-PINNED waiver of interlock precondition 5 (the independent clean-row bar). Valid ONLY while the live money-core digest equals `digest` below — any money-core edit voids it, the same F2 law that binds a ledger row, so a waiver can never become a permanent global token. Created by an owner ruling recorded in the operating harness's decisions log; a counter-ruling DELETES this file and the bar returns whole. A future release either meets the bar or carries a NEW recorded ruling with a fresh digest. This file ships with the tree ON PURPOSE: the public release-proof evaluates the same gate the source did, and a bar that was waived should say so in the open.
ruling: The owner waives the independent-review row for the fee-rail + live-day release at this exact digest ('can we just push now', 2026-08-18 ~23:00, in direct response to 'the only gate left is the row') — the THIRD use of the recorded-ruling channel in three days; the pattern warning to the co-principal stands and is restated, not softened. The reviewer's row was requested FIRST, twice: w-118/w-119 (digests that died under the live-testing day's fixes, per their own w-88 complaint) and w-132 (sent at this digest with the all-day freeze documented run-by-run, the full-cap sweep records at these exact bytes, and the delta itemized); their lane had not spawned to read it by ~23:00. Their retroactive read stands welcome and requested. Substance: ~15 owner-reported walls fixed same-hour under live testing (the burn-route divert closed with one quiet retry + generation-aware sizing, the floor-law max, the covered-wallet refuel branch), the sale fee lane, the protection dial, and an additive hardening wave; A12 full-cap-swept clean at the shipped bytes with every survivor verdicted, one real boundary pinned red-under-mutant.
